entities.name: Bilâl Göregen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bilal Göregen is a Turkish street musician and drummer. He is blind and has become famous via his rendition of Ievan polkka, wherein a Twitter user superimposed a cat bobbing its head on his video. YouTube has shared his performing video on Instagram.

entities.summary: Bilal Göregen is a Turkish street musician and drummer. He is blind and has become famous via his rendition of Ievan polkka, wherein a Twitter user superimposed a cat bobbing its head on his video. YouTube has shared his performing video on Instagram.
